query.en: Create an 80.81-second product launch film. Open behind a developer in a late-night studio with a San Francisco 11:54 PM PST label. A desktop notification from Bin Liu says we need to launch studio tomorrow, followed by a Slack reply, sounds good!, and a dock click opening the app. Type {{launchRequest}}. On an ivory stage, the mint-green Nib mascot wears round glasses and reads a yellow Launch Videos for Dummies book; a lightbulb flashes before a floating launch card spins into a multitrack timeline with voiceover, clicks, whooshes and keys. Reveal Introducing {{product}}, then the multicolored halftone preview reading {{headline}}. Draw a mint ellipse around the type, enter make this bigger, then comment make humans mint; the last word changes to {{primary}}. Add an A-roll of the bespectacled man in a grassy field to the editor. Slide the preview upward into a moving gallery of project tiles with Set the vision and Watch it become video. Type a succession of podcast clipping, interview captions, vertical reframing, color grading and music editing requests, ending with {{socialRequest}}. A vertical portrait of the woman in a white blazer resolves from colorful particles, then appears above a timeline with graphics, B-roll and caption tracks. The Export pill collapses into a glossy black ball. Follow it through beige mechanical X, Instagram, TikTok and YouTube stations, each with a portrait upload screen, progress bar, publishing button and moving rails. Finish with an illuminated beige wall bearing the black {{parentBrand}}, {{brand}} and Studio wordmark and mint icon. Use the following swappable reference picture elements: book {{book}}; gallery_purple {{gallery_purple}}; office_person {{office_person}}; platform_youtube {{platform_youtube}}; gallery_desktop {{gallery_desktop}}; man {{man}}; gallery_terminal {{gallery_terminal}}; platform_instagram {{platform_instagram}}; intro_card {{intro_card}}; office_monitor {{office_monitor}}; woman {{woman}}; office_screen {{office_screen}}; launch_card {{launch_card}}; platform_x {{platform_x}}; platform_tiktok {{platform_tiktok}}; gallery_trees {{gallery_trees}};  gallery-calendar image {{gallery_calendar}}; building image {{building}}; gallery-vision image {{gallery_vision}}; Use {{slack_avatar}} for the chat avatar and {{dock_settings}} / {{dock_slack}} for Dock icons.
query.zh-CN: 为 {{product}} 制作 80.81 秒产品发布片：先从深夜工作室背影和 11:54 PM PST 的时间标记推入，桌面收到 Bin Liu 的发布通知，Slack 对话回复 sounds good!，点击应用后逐字输入 {{launchRequest}}。白底上戴圆眼镜的薄荷绿 Nib 翻看黄色 Launch Videos for Dummies，灯泡亮起，再托起发布片卡片。卡片旋转进入多轨时间线，依次添加 Voiceover、Clicks、Whoosh 和 Keys。黑色卡片显示 Introducing {{product}}，然后展示 {{headline}} 的彩色网点预览；光标圈出标题，输入 make this bigger，再评论 make humans mint，humans 变为 {{primary}}。插入田野里戴眼镜男子的 A-roll，在编辑器里播放，然后让作品墙向上翻动，出现 Set the vision / Watch it become video。白底逐条打出播客剪辑、采访字幕、竖屏重构、调色与配乐请求，最后输入 {{socialRequest}}。长发白外套女性竖屏素材由彩色粒子聚合出现，底部时间线添加图形、B-roll 和字幕轨。Export 按钮收缩成黑色弹珠，弹珠依次经过 X、Instagram、TikTok、YouTube 米色立体机械装置；手机屏显示上传、进度和发布状态。最后镜头收束到暖米色墙面的 {{parentBrand}} / {{brand}} / Studio 黑色立体品牌字与薄荷绿图标。 保留以下可替换原片素材：画面素材 book {{book}}；画面素材 gallery-purple {{gallery_purple}}；画面素材 office-person {{office_person}}；画面素材 platform-youtube {{platform_youtube}}；画面素材 gallery-desktop {{gallery_desktop}}；画面素材 man {{man}}；画面素材 gallery-terminal {{gallery_terminal}}；画面素材 platform-instagram {{platform_instagram}}；画面素材 intro-card {{intro_card}}；画面素材 office-monitor {{office_monitor}}；画面素材 woman {{woman}}；画面素材 office-screen {{office_screen}}；画面素材 launch-card {{launch_card}}；画面素材 platform-x {{platform_x}}；画面素材 platform-tiktok {{platform_tiktok}}；画面素材 gallery-trees {{gallery_trees}}； 画面素材 gallery-calendar {{gallery_calendar}}; 画面素材 building {{building}}; 画面素材 gallery-vision {{gallery_vision}}; 聊天头像使用 {{slack_avatar}}，Dock 图标使用 {{dock_settings}} / {{dock_slack}}。
